messages:
alex (eng-runtime): heads up — i'm going to run a quick throughput sweep with the new priority-pacing hook. need regression checks + profiling runs. low-risk and can be evening (PST) window.

maria (perf): ok — which variants? max_batch 64/128? var max_tokens?

alex (eng-runtime): going to test: max_batch=[64,128], max_tokens=[512,1024], priority_pacing=on/off. target qps ~800-1200 per gpu. small smoke first.

sam (perf): please tag the PR and include the loadgen command. i'll grab perf traces if you kick it off.

alex (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.redwood/infra/runner/pulls/452 — diff adds pacing hook + priority queue flag.

alex (eng-runtime): loadgen command i'll use:
```
./run_loadgen --model=redwood-7b --qps=1000 --concurrency=32 --max-batch=64 --max-tokens=512 --duration=600 --tags=pacing-sweep
```

ryan (sre): FYI, I'll reserve nodes 3-5 on staging-GPU from 19:00-21:00 PST. set a `do-not-evict` label.

jess (eng-platform): adding a routing policy to avoid hitting prod routing. patching stage config now.

maria (perf): when you start, pls add a `--trace-mode=kv-cache` run so i can pull KV hit rates. also include a control run w/o pacing.

alex (eng-runtime): noted. sequence: control -> pacing=on (no priority) -> pacing=on + priority enabled -> larger batch. will push artifacts to /artifacts/throughput/2419998888.

sam (perf): CI job name? i'd like the flamegraphs attached to the build.

alex (eng-runtime): CI job is `perf/sweep-staging` — i'll post run id.

ci-bot: perf/sweep-staging #452 started by alex at 2026-03-17T19:05:12Z — tracking artifacts 

alex (eng-runtime): run1 (control) finished — avg latency 48ms, p50=45ms, p95=110ms, throughput=980 tps. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2419998888/run1

maria (perf): grabbing traces now. KV hit-rate looks low on control (~12%). cache warmup maybe needed.

sam (perf): run2 (pacing on no priority) kicked — note: i'm attaching perf top.

ci-bot: perf/sweep-staging #452 run2 finished — avg latency 52ms, throughput 1150 tps; artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2419998888/run2

maria (perf): interesting — throughput up but p95 regressed a bit. KV hit-rate improved to 28% for run2. attaching flamegraph link.

alex (eng-runtime): run3 (pacing + priority) queued. wondering if priority starving small requests; can we run a sample with mixed payload sizes?

sam (perf): do 80% small (64 tokens), 20% large (1024 tokens) to mimic client mix. that will reveal preemption effects.

alex (eng-runtime): good call. running mixed payload profile.

ci-bot: perf/sweep-staging #452 run3 finished — avg latency 57ms, throughput 1180 tps; artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2419998888/run3

maria (perf): preliminary: priority pacing increased overall throughput but p95 for small requests moved from 110ms -> 160ms in mixed workload. KV cache helped long tails but small requests see queueing delays.

ryan (sre): if small requests are SLO-sensitive, we can add a reserved microqueue (capacity 8) for small token requests. low-cost change. thoughts?

jess (eng-platform): routing + reserved microqueue looks safe. need config change PR and a short rollout. I can own the PR.

alex (eng-runtime): agreed. next steps: jess opens config PR for microqueue + rollout plan; sam/maria to run 1 more sweep with microqueue emulated (local flag); i'll annotate perf runs and update the regression ticket.

maria (perf): will run the emulation tomorrow morning and attach comparisons.

sam (perf): ping me when you start, i'll parallelize trace collection.

alex (eng-runtime): thanks all. putting notes into the cb-regressions board and linking artifacts. tagging @jess to start PR. :thumbsup:

jess (eng-platform): on it — PR link when ready.

alex (eng-runtime): last message — if anyone wants a deep dive, i'll do a short async writeup of the flamegraphs and KV stats.

maria (perf): please do, that would help the rollout decision. :+1:

ci-bot: perf/sweep-staging #452 completed overall at 2026-03-17T19:12:08Z
